relevant_laws: a config exposing `mask_token_id`, or an architecture ending `ForMaskedLM`, is NOT autoregressive.
ForCausalLM in the architecture name is NOT proof of autoregression -- some diffusion language models reuse that class name.
num_experts / num_local_experts mean MoE: stored bytes and ACTIVE bytes differ, and complete accounting must say which it is quoting.
state_size / a recurrent mixer means the persistent state is not a KV cache; state cost is per-layer and constant in context, not linear.
an encoder body has no KV cache to grow and its bottleneck is the single forward pass, not decode bandwidth.
complete EBPW counts EVERY required byte -- payload, scales, zeros, norms, embeddings. A headline precision is not a system rate.
